title: Appoint a member of a limited liability partnership (LL AP01c)
text:
You may file this form if you have chosen to state that your registered office address is situated in Wales as opposed to England and Wales.

 This form can be used to notify Companies House about an individual being appointed as a member of an LLP.

 It is easier and quicker to file your appointment form online .

 Do not use this form if the LLP is in the PROOF (PROtected Online Filing) Scheme .
